articles.summary: MDU Resources Group, Inc.’s (NYSE: MDU) board of directors has selected the management team who will lead Knife River Corporation, the company’s construction materials subsidiary, effective upon completion of the anticipated separation of Knife River into an independent, publicly traded company.
articles.title: MDU Resources Board of Directors Names Leadership for Knife River Upon Separation

articles.summary: Knife River Corporation announced today that it has partnered with the Oregon Chapter of the National Association of Minority Contractors (NAMC-Oregon) to provide $250,000 in training scholarships for historically underrepresented groups.
articles.title: Knife River Partners With National Association of Minority Contractors on Training Scholarships
